segments.text: All right, so you walk up to a couple of marines who are staying there.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: I walk up and go, excuse me, officers, if I may call you that?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Is there any reason why you're patrolling the docks?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: I feel as if your guys' presence, there must be something awry.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Captain orders to have a detachment down here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Apparently there was some bloodshed a night ago or so.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: In a place called the Chart Room.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Apparently, however, the men that killed them were a little bit more skilled than many.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Oh my goodness, are we okay?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That puts me more at ease.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: If I could ask you one last thing.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: I lost my company of who I was working for, and I have no idea how to travel and trade
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: I am a merchant and I've been trying to trade back to Monmurg, of all places, to get some more goods.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: I just, I figured I would at least try and get some stuff back here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: I've heard that there is a new dock opening up in Saltmarsh if you want to go there.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Or you can take your wares to Seton.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There are ships that go there if you'd like.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: This place is a lot safer with you around.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: We don't want those foreign spies to cause any more trouble.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I shake his hand, but it's very limp.
